# Twenty CRM — application UI reference

- **Source:** https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty and https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/blob/main/DESIGN.md
- **Inspected:** 2026-11-15. GitHub README and the repository’s `DESIGN.md` content were fetched. No live product UI or screenshots were visually inspected; implementation source was not audited.
- **License / reuse:** The repository license was not checked during this review. Do not copy Twenty’s code, assets, tokens, or product-specific conventions without checking the current license and project fit.

## Useful qualities to study

The product design document describes a calm, dense, keyboard-first CRM, semantic color roles, a 4px spacing rhythm, mostly flat surfaces, restrained elevation, consistent icon roles, reusable components, and explicit patterns for settings, tables, side panels, forms, menus, and commands. These are documented product rules, not observations of the live UI.

## Relevance to ChargesTBA

Potentially useful for clear navigation, compact data views, consistent setting sections, action hierarchy, and separating fields from commands. Adapt to a simpler household finance workflow; do not import CRM-specific object terminology, command architecture, or exact measurements by default.

- **Observed:** Repository README and `DESIGN.md` documentation inspected.
